$comment: Documentation of the intake contract between GDX_SKILL_NEW_STUDY (writer) and GDX_SKILL_RECORD_NEW_STUDY (reader). This is not enforced by a JSON-Schema library at runtime -- validate_intake.py hand-checks the same rules so neither skill needs an extra dependency. Column length limits are copied from psychometrics_model_firebird25.sql; keep them in sync if the DDL changes.

name.description: GDX_PSY_INSTRUMENT.NAME -- checked against check_catalog.js output before asking; must not collide with an existing instrument unless the user is intentionally adding a new version.

version.description: GDX_PSY_INSTRUMENT.VERSION -- a short year/edition tag ONLY (e.g. '2024'), never the full author citation (VARCHAR(30) -- see catalog.py's truncation warning).

type.description: GDX_PSY_INSTRUMENT.TYPE, e.g. LIKERT_SCALE, SINGLE_ITEM, SEMANTIC_DIFFERENTIAL, VISUAL_ANALOG.

description.description: GDX_PSY_INSTRUMENT.DESCRIPTION -- put full author citation here.

instructions.description: GDX_PSY_INSTRUMENT.INSTRUCTIONS (BLOB, no hard limit) -- the instruction text shown to a respondent before the items.

phenomenon_name.description: GDX_PSY_PHENOMENON.NAME -- must be UNIQUE in the whole database; reuse an existing one (see check_catalog.js) if this instrument measures a phenomenon already cataloged.

construct_name.description: Must match a constructs[].name in this same instrument.

indicator_name.description: GDX_PSY_INDICATOR.NAME -- unique per variable; usually '<Variable name> (score)'.

direction.description: POSITIVE if a higher raw score means more of the construct, NEGATIVE if less.

response_anchor_sets.description: Named, reusable groups of response alternatives, so a 30-item Likert instrument only has to state its 5 anchors once instead of once per item.

key.description: Local id referenced by items[].anchor_set. Not persisted as-is; each item still gets its own GDX_PSY_ITEM_ALTERNATIVE rows.

statement_text.description: GDX_PSY_INSTRUMENT_ITEM.STATEMENT_TEXT (BLOB, no hard limit) -- the exact wording read by the respondent.

response_type.description: GDX_PSY_INSTRUMENT_ITEM.RESPONSE_TYPE, e.g. LIKERT_5, LIKERT_7, BINARY, SINGLE_ITEM.

anchor_set.description: Must match a response_anchor_sets[].key in this same instrument; null only for response types with no fixed alternatives (e.g. open text).

variable_name.description: Which variables[].name (dimension) this item feeds. An item that loads on more than one dimension can be listed with extra_variables (see below).

reversed.description: GDX_PSY_INDICATOR_ITEM.REVERSED -- 1 if this item is reverse-scored for its indicator.

extra_variables.description: Optional: additional (variable_name, reversed, indicator_item_weight) entries for an item that also loads on other dimensions besides variable_name.
